test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct Speech.

She told us that she had not seen the movie.

options.text: She said, "I didn't see the movie."
she said, "I haven't seen the movie."
She said, "I had not seen the movie."
She said, "She hadn't seen the movie."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** She told us that she had not seen the movie.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"she had not seen the movie" becomes "I had not seen the movie"**
 
 
• Pronoun "she" is changed t
